For questions, revocation requests, or notices, contact OpenSportsLab through

## Maintainer activation

Create a repository issue named **CLA Signature Ledger**. Set that issue number
in [`cla.yml`](cla.yml) before enabling this workflow as a required status
check. The workflow must also be present on the repository default branch for
GitHub to process signature comments. Only bot-authored acceptance records are
authoritative; do not edit or delete them.

> **Legal review required:** Before enabling this workflow, an authorized
> OpenSportsLab legal representative must review this text and replace the
> project name/contact route with the exact legal counterparty and notice
> details if required.
